summary: For a visit, Lurie advises families to bring the child's current medications and pharmacy contact information, available medical records and test results, any insurance-required referrals, and the insurance card and co-payment.
source_title: Preparing for Your Appointment at Lurie Children's

summary: Use the facility name or address on your appointment to look up reviewed public parking instructions. VisitReady asks you to confirm unclear destinations and does not check live parking availability.

Lurie Children's MyChart supports touchless E-check-in, updating insurance information, and completing questionnaires online. Review your appointment details in MyChart; for registration questions, contact Lurie Children's directly. This demo is not connected to MyChart and cannot check or update registration.
